name: PdxMenubar
description: A horizontal menu bar whose entries open dropdown submenus, as in File, Edit, View.

members.name: trigger
members.description:
Open mode: 'click' (default) opens on a click, and then the pointer moves between menus
while one is open, as a desktop menubar does; 'hover' opens on mouseenter alone.

members.name: openMenu
members.description: Open one top-level menu by key, focusing its first item (its last with 'last'). A disabled or unknown key opens nothing.

members.name: closeMenu
members.description: Close the open menu and any submenu under it. The boolean it takes is not read.

events.name: pdx-select
events.description: An entry was chosen: its `key` and its item.

events.name: pdx-check
events.description: A checkbox or radio entry was toggled: its `key`, whether it is checked, its radio group.
events.detail: { key: string; checked: boolean | undefined; radioGroup?: string; item: MenuItem }

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description:
Open mode: 'click' (default) opens on a click, and then the pointer moves between menus
while one is open, as a desktop menubar does; 'hover' opens on mouseenter alone.

cssParts.name: trigger
cssParts.description: A top-level entry; the one whose menu is open is `aria-expanded="true"`.

cssParts.name: item
cssParts.description: An entry of the open menu, or of a submenu.

cssParts.name: separator
cssParts.description: The rule between two groups of entries.

cssStates.name: open
cssStates.description: One of its menus is open.
